description: This file defines the AttemptCompletionTool class, a specialized tool for handling task completion attempts within a larger task management system. It includes methods for executing completion logic, handling partial inputs, and delegating to parent tasks, with integrations for telemetry, configuration, and subtask management.

classes.name: AttemptCompletionTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool that manages task completion attempts, including execution, partial handling, and delegation logic.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters into AttemptCompletionParams object.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to execute the attempt completion process, handling success, errors, and delegation.

methods.name: delegateToParent
methods.description: Handles delegation flow to parent task when a subtask completes.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial input blocks for the attempt completion tool.
